prompt: An empty restaurant kitchen back wall seen straight on, used as a game screen background: a deep navy blue tiled wall with a long stainless steel ticket rail across the upper third, a dark steel shelf below it, and a strip of brushed steel counter edge along the lower part of the frame. Bold flat vector illustration with thick dark ink outlines, chunky simple shapes and big readable silhouettes, like a polished mobile strategy game. Warm palette of brushed steel greys, hot orange flame, tomato red and mustard yellow, lit by even soft top light with crisp edges. The upper and lower thirds stay simple and low contrast so text reads over them.
